fluff.overview: Navies throughout history have sought dedicated marines, soldiers they can tailor to suit shipboard needs and requirements. Clan Snow Raven continues this tradition, fielding Space Marine Points drawn from warriors of all phenotypes to guard its fleet from internal threats. Unlike battle armor troops, these marines have limited mobility and are best suited to defensive operations, providing security and boarding defense on spacecraft ranging from WarShips to observation stations. Armed with Mauser IIC assault systems and fitted with marine environment suits, they can fight effectively in zero-gravity and vacuum conditions. The introduction of the Aerie power armor has raised questions about the future of unarmored marines within the Snow Raven touman, but the Aerie's prohibitive cost ensures that conventional marines will continue to fill shipboard security roles for the foreseeable future.
